Release sweep 2026-11-08 — raw logs

Every release from v0.0.1 to v0.1.12, re-measured under identical conditions on a dedicated lab VM (Google Cloud c4-highmem-8, Ubuntu 26.10, same machine type as the production x86 origin). No production host was loaded: the server and the load generator both ran inside the lab VM, over its own loopback, with the server pinned to cores 0–3 and h2load to cores 4–7.

Each release was PGO-built from its public tag with one unified gather profile (Rust 1.99.1), then served with the current production flags (uniform for all ten builds — no per-build dropped flags; see *.dropped in the bench run, all empty). Three rounds per build in rotated order (round 2 reversed); the published curve shows medians. Fixtures are the repository bench fixtures: 1 KiB static file, /robots.txt through the real 806-line forum .htaccess chain, bench.php?n=50 over the real lsphp (PHP 8.5.12), and a 37 KB PHP fixture page (cachebench.php) served through the real origin page cache — the lab has no XenForo database, so the cache workload is a fixture, not a forum page. TLS used a lab self-signed RSA-2048 certificate; heavy-.htaccess H2 is connection-bound on that certificate (~110k req/s for every build), so read its H1 line for trend.

Per-round numbers: release-sweep-2026-11-08.tsv. Driver: lab-bench.sh · provisioning: lab-setup.sh · binary hashes: binaries.sha256 · run order: progress.log · cache primes: prime.log · server logs: serve-<tag>.log beside this page. All 180 runs finished with zero 4xx/5xx responses.
